headline: HuyenBao v11.43 — sửa 5 bug bằng lái (label 'Cần bằng lái' → 'Không đủ tiền' + i18n + short course)
summary: LICENCE BUG FIXES. 5 bugs found and fixed in the licence system. (A) WRONG BUTTON LABEL: when the player couldn't afford a licence, the enrol button showed 'Cần bằng lái' (Need licence) on a licence enrol button — making it look broken. Now correctly shows 'Không đủ tiền' (Not enough cash). (B) MISSING I18N KEY: 'parallelStudyNote' was undefined → rendered as literal text. Now uses existing 'multiStudyNote' key. (C) MISSING LIC.MECHANIC: the mechanic licence had no translations → showed English in VI/ZH. Now has full EN/VI/ZH. (D) EMPTY 'NEEDED FOR': boat/pilot/mechanic licences showed 'needed for' with nothing after it. Now localises category names + hides the segment when empty. (E) SHORT COURSE POLLUTION: short courses (bootcamp, MBA-fast, etc.) reused kind:'lic' and wrote to s.lic on completion — polluting the licence map + mislabelling as 'Licence' in toasts/logs. Now finishStudy checks SHORT_BY and skips the s.lic write + says 'Short course' not 'Licence'.
features: BUG A FIX: licence enrol button 'Cần bằng lái' → 'Không đủ tiền' when can't afford
BUG B FIX: missing 'parallelStudyNote' i18n key → use existing 'multiStudyNote'
BUG C FIX: missing 'lic.mechanic' translations → added EN/VI/ZH
BUG D FIX: 'needed for' empty for boat/pilot/mechanic → localise + hide when empty
BUG E FIX: short courses no longer write to s.lic + correctly labelled 'Short course' in toasts/logs
